messages:
Sam Huang: hey everyone, just started as Product Designer today 44b. Quick runbook request: how do I get Figma + Notion access, wheres the canonical product roadmap, and where do research session recordings live? Also whos my onboarding buddy?

Bea (design-ops): welcome Sam! :tada: I manage design access. DM me your work email and Ill add you to the "Product Design" Figma team and the design Notion group. We also have a short onboarding checklist in Notion.

Sam Huang: thanks Bea  sending DM. A couple of extra Qs: do we lock the components library? how do designers propose token changes?

Bea (design-ops): good Q. Library updates go through the weekly UI release process: branch in Figma, PR in the ui-releases doc, then a release owner merges. Token changes should include a short rollout note and test plan.

Ivy (PM): roadmap is in Notion: https://notion.redwood.com/product/roadmap. PMs maintain initiative pages; designers are given commenter by default but we can grant edit on a per-initiative basis. Tag me if you want edit access for any initiative.

Marco (UX Research): hi Sam, recordings are on Research Drive; synths + highlights are in Notion under Research > Artifacts. We also keep a "lab schedule" calendar for moderated sessions. If you want a reading pack for onboarding flows, tell me and Ill bundle 3 synths.

Sam Huang: reading pack please  onboarding flows. Also, is there a recommended way to leave research annotations in Figma?

Marco (UX Research): we use comment threads with the prefix "Research:" and the study tag (e.g., Research: Onboard-Funnel). For wider notes, drop a short summary in the Notion artifact and link the Figma file. Ill add you to the lab calendar invite so you can shadow a session.

devex-bot: Tip: run `/request-access figma product` to auto-open a design-ops ticket.

Bea (design-ops): Sam, sent Figma invite to sam@redwood.com and Notion invite. Also added you to the "Design Onboarding" Notion page which has component guidelines and accessibility checklist.

Sam Huang: got invites, thanks! Last one: who should I ping for mac setup + local preview (so I can test components with frontend)?

Ivy (PM): ping @eng-frontend in #eng; Ill intro you to the squad frontend buddy. They usually do a 30m pairing session to get your local preview running.

Sam Huang: perfect, appreciate the help 60a. Looking forward to meeting folks in the crits this week.
